C1215.title: FBI Reports a Surge in U.S. SIM Swap Complaints and Losses
C1215.summary: On February 8, 2022, the FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center reported 320 SIM swapping complaints and about $12 million in adjusted losses from 2018 through 2020. In 2021 alone, complaints rose to 1,611 with losses exceeding $68 million. The bulletin said criminals use social engineering, insiders, or phishing to induce carriers to transfer victims' phone numbers.
